information.multiple_directories: Only one directory can be imported at a time.
information.no_files_for_rename: No files were loaded that can be renamed.

errors.read_failed: The modified file could not be read.
errors.editor_count_mismatch: The number of lines in the file does not match the number of loaded files.
errors.conflicts_found: Naming conflicts were detected. The affected files cannot be renamed:
errors.missing_sources: One or more source files could not be found:
errors.missing_sources_undo: One or more source files could not be found during undo:

warnings.name_too_long: At least one destination name is too long. Renaming is not possible.

menu.act_add_files: Adds one or more individual files
menu.act_add_folder: Adds all files from a selected folder
menu.act_reset: Resets all settings to their default values

rename.edit_mask: Defines the pattern for new filenames
rename.btn_name_slice: Inserts a part of the original name, e.g. {name1-3} or {name4-*}
rename.btn_counter: Generates sequential numbering according to the counter settings
rename.btn_date: Replaced according to the selected date format
rename.btn_time: Replaced according to the selected time format
rename.cmb_date: Specifies the date format used for {date}
rename.cmb_date_sep: Specifies the separator between date components
rename.cmb_time: Specifies the time format used for {time}
rename.cmb_time_sep: Specifies the separator between time components
rename.cmb_datetype: Determines which date is used – current or modified date

extension.edit_ext: Defines the pattern for the new file extension
extension.btn_ext_slice: Inserts part of the original extension, e.g. {ext1-2} or {ext2-*}
extension.btn_counter: Generates sequential numbering according to the counter settings

replace.edit_search: Defines the search term or pattern to be replaced in filenames
replace.edit_replace: Defines the text to insert in place of the found term
replace.cb_regex: Enables the use of regular expressions in the search field
replace.cb_first_match: Limits replacement to the first match per filename
replace.cb_exact_matches: Requires an exact match of the entire name instead of partial matches
replace.cb_case_sens: Distinguishes between uppercase and lowercase letters when searching

counter.spin_start: Sets the starting value of the counter where numbering begins
counter.spin_step: Specifies how much the counter increases with each file
counter.spin_digits: Defines how many digits the counter is padded to with leading zeros if needed
counter.cb_dupes: Restricts counter numbering to files with identical base names

advanced_opts.cmb_case: Defines how the letter case of new filenames is adjusted
advanced_opts.cb_windows: Replaces characters that are not allowed in file names under Windows
advanced_opts.cb_windows_forced:
Replaces characters that are not allowed in file names under Windows
(always active under Windows)
advanced_opts.btn_editor: Opens the current preview in an external text editor for manual editing

actions.btn_undo: Undoes the last renaming operation (works only until the program is closed!)

table.filename_too_long_windows: Name or path is too long. (Windows)
table.filename_too_long_linux: Name or path exceeds the byte limit. (Linux)
